title: Events
intro: Every event is kept as its own record: its report, its floor plan and the figures to compare it by.
cacheNote: Cache savings appear once a game cache source reports them.
none: No event closed yet. When this one is over, close it below and it appears here.
name: Name
deleteQuestion: Delete {{name}} with its report and floor plan? This can't be undone.
closeTitle: Close this event and start the next
closeHelp: The event is kept with its report and floor plan. The next one starts from it: the floor plan, settings, build plan and your teardown steps stay; the report's history, incidents, handovers, pre-flight results and the gear log start again. Gear still out stays out.
nextNameHelp: Optional. Becomes the event name in the theme settings.
closed: {{name}} is closed and kept. The next event has started.
